about: Attorney Jeffrey M. Tillotson is the founder and partner of Tillotson Law Firm in Dallas, Texas. Widely regarded as one of the top lawyers in his region, Mr. Tillotson provides exceptional counsel and support to a diverse range of clients throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex and surrounding areas who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Over the course of his legal career, Mr. Tillotson has achieved remarkable success securing favorable outcomes for his clients in highly complex litigation, and he has served as counsel in numerous multiparty cases in various jurisdictions across the country. Many of these cases incurred intense media scrutiny and were featured on a variety of news outlets, including the CBS Evening News and The Wall Street Journal.

Honored for his remarkable professionalism and service, Mr. Tillotson has earned designation as a Top 100 Trial Lawyer from Benchmark Litigation as well as designation as one of the Most Powerful Business Leaders in Dallas-Fort Worth. He has also received many other accolades and endorsements from his peers along with numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A 1983 graduate of the London School of Economics and Political Science, Mr. Tillotson received his Bachelor of Science in foreign service from Georgetown University in 1984 and his Juris Doctor from The University of Texas School of Law in 1987. He holds his license to practice in Texas and California, and he is admitted to practice before all U.S. District Courts in Texas and California.

Mr. Tillotson is a member of the American Board of Trial Advocates and the American Bar Association, among his other professional affiliations, and he serves on the board of trustees for Parkland Memorial Hospital.
